methods.label: Division and bag interpretation
methods.explanation: \(23\div5=4\text{ remainder }3\). This fills 4 bags, with 3 balls left over.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 2 division with remainders and interprets full groups and leftovers.

review.mathematicalCheck: Four bags hold 5 × 4 = 20 balls, leaving 23 − 20 = 3. Since 3 < 5, quotient 4 and remainder 3 are valid. The bag interpretation sufficiently explains the result.
